raw_storage_semantics: pre-action state/image paired with the same-row action

source_evidence.evidence: After the first env.step returns, the wrapper first appends _current_task_instance_state, the initial state before that action.
Each action then appends the resulting simulator state and the action, producing T+1 states for T actions.
The final extra state is deleted, leaving [initial state, ..., state after action T-2] aligned with actions [0, ..., T-1].
Conversion resets to states[t], renders that state, and writes actions[t] into the same LeRobot row.

numerical_evidence.interpretation: The state transition following stored observation t agrees more strongly with action[t] than action[t+1], corroborating the source-derived shift 0 convention.

video_evidence: All 1,521 videos have the same episode length, frame rate, and row count as their corresponding parquet. Three two-view samples decode with frame correspondence intact.
raw_annotation_index: Read raw annotation row t for action[t]. No semantic regrouping or timeline transformation is performed in R1.
previous_audit_correction: The earlier post-action interpretation relied on an ambiguous collect_demos comment and missed the initial-state insertion in DataCollectionWrapper. It is superseded by this full source and numerical audit.
